passage:
Ira had typed "Pema's notes are copied from some topper's blog, everyone should know" into the class group, thumb over send. Ira deleted it and opened a private chat.
Ira: congrats on physics. 96 again
Pema: thanks!! chem nearly killed me though 😅
Ira: how do you revise?? I read the chapter 3 times and still blank
Pema: I don't read, I do old papers first, mark my mistakes in red and only revise those
Ira: that's actually smart. can I see your mistakes page?
Pema: sure, swap notebooks tomorrow
Ira: ok. also I was kind of jealous, ngl
Pema: lol I'm jealous of your drawings so we're even 🙂
Ira put the phone down. Chem had never shown up on any rank list.

qa.q: How does Pema say revision works?
qa.a: Pema does old papers first, marks mistakes in red and only revises those.

qa.q: What was Ira feeling when typing the message about Pema's notes, and what shows Ira changed course?
qa.a: Ira felt small and bitter, and deleting the draft, then asking how Pema revises, shows Ira chose to learn instead.

qa.q: What small step could Ira take once the notebooks are swapped?
qa.a: Try Pema's method on one subject and see if it helps, while remembering that a rank is only one narrow measure.

qa.q: How might Pema see Ira's message "kind of jealous"?
qa.a: Pema takes it lightly and admits being jealous of Ira's drawings, so Pema feels envy too and did not feel attacked.

grounding: Ira feels small and bitter about a classmate who tops every test, drops the rumour and asks how the classmate studies.
